verdict.rationale: A state business-filing portal could plausibly offer an API with scoped credentials, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only bot walls (Akamai 403, Incapsula interstitials) on www.nvsos.gov and the ORION portal. Nothing documents any API, credential issuance, or permission scoping.
